task_description: Build 'Ecossistema': a React + TypeScript (.tsx) web page that manages a team of AI agents (IA CEO, Arquiteto, Front-end, Back-end, Integrador) which collaboratively build a web programming project from a single user prompt. One agent may hold multiple roles. Ships with a deterministic offline mock agent engine behind a swappable LLMProvider interface (no external LLM API access in the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox). No-bundler setup (Bun transpile + browser import map to CDN) because the npm registry is blocked. Includes Portuguese README and .gitignore; git left clean and ready to commit (no push, no PR).
